name: lp-hero
description: Opening section for long-form and utility pages (legal pages, guides, webinar replays, event pages): breadcrumbs, eyebrow, the page h1, a lede with optional links, a small meta line and an optional button, over the soft colour wash. center: one centred column (legal pages, replays). split: copy left, a rounded picture card right, stacked below 992px (the government guides). banner: centred copy over a wide picture (the AWS re:Invent page).

layout.description: center: one centred column. split: copy beside a picture card. banner: copy centred over a wide picture.

tone.description: wash: the soft colour wash (background picture, or the kit's gradient when none is given). white: plain white.

background.description: Wash picture URL, drawn cover-sized (tone wash). Empty draws the kit's own soft gradient.

crumbs.description: Breadcrumb trail after Home, in order. Each: label (required) and url (empty for the current page, which should come last).

home_url.description: Home link of the breadcrumb trail.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: The page heading (h1). Line breaks are kept; UrsaAI is set with its superscript.

lede.description: Paragraph under the heading. Line breaks are kept, **double asterisks** bold, [label](url) makes a link (http(s), mailto:, tel:, a path or #anchor); UrsaAI is set with its superscript.

meta.description: Small line under the lede, e.g. Last updated: January 1, 2026.

cta_label.description: Button text. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Button destination (a page, or #anchor on the page).

image.description: Picture for the split and banner layouts.

image_width.description: Picture intrinsic width in px. 0 omits it.

image_height.description: Picture intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.
